newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose slightly to 2.27 billion yuan from 2.252 billion with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range with volume little changed due to a balance of short-term fund demand and supply on the market.
The state-run banks and short-term financing centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, have had ample money supply on hand recently partly due to surging bank deposits, they said.
Money demand has also increased with the active stock markets attracting non-banking financial institutions including securities houses to borrow heavily on the interbank market.
Traders said they expected the interbank rates to remain stable in the short-term.
